CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwCotas]
AS

views.Series_Cotas:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[Series_Cotas]
AS
SELECT Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, MIN(Data) AS Inicio, MAX(Data) AS Fim, MediaDiaria
FROM Cotas
WHERE (Temporario = 0) AND (Removido = 0) AND (Data IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, MediaDiaria
views.Series_Vazoes:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[Series_Vazoes]
AS
SELECT Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, MIN(Data) AS Inicio, MAX(Data) AS Fim, MediaDiaria
FROM Vazoes
WHERE (Temporario = 0) AND (Removido = 0) AND (Data IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, MediaDiaria
views.Series_Uniao_Cotas:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[Series_Uniao_Cotas]
AS
	SELECT Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, Min(Data) AS Inicio, 	Max(Data) AS Fim, MediaDiaria AS TipoReg, MediaDiaria
	FROM Cotas
	WHERE (((Temporario)=0) AND ((Removido)=0)) AND (Data IS NOT NULL)
	GROUP BY Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, MediaDiaria

	UNION SELECT Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia, Min(Data) AS Inicio, 	Max(Data) AS Fim, 11 AS TipoReg, 0 AS MediaDiaria
	FROM Cotas24
	WHERE (((Temporario)=0) AND ((Removido)=0)) AND (Data IS NOT NULL)
	GROUP BY Importado, EstacaoCodigo, NivelConsistencia;
